'''Lonai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kumumgah/Legends|Kumumgah]] and the [[Parent/Legends|son]] of an [[Lonai's father|older Kumumgah]] who adorned his head with a large headdress. He lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire's]] rule, when the planet was [[Conquest of Tatooine|conquered]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] and his [[City/Legends|city]] burned. Brought out onto a cliff on the outskirts of the ruined city with his father and another [[Unidentified Kumumgah|young boy]], Lonai knelt shackled before [[Predor]] [[Tul'kar]] as the [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] determined who among them was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Forceful]]. Determining the other boy to be capable of touching the Force, the Rakatan guards killed Lonai and his father, who were deemed worthless, before escorting the other boy to a ship which would take him [[Planet/Legends|offworld]].
